answer.reason: The verses tell of Nathanael being brought to Jesus and confessing him as the Son of God, which goes beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was brought to Jesus by Philip, who told him they had found the one Moses wrote of
clauses.quote: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him

clauses.english: confessed Jesus as the Son of God and King of Israel after Jesus said he had seen him under the fig tree
clauses.quote: Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
